newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Washington Mutual Inc.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Washington Mutual Inc.

text.p: Smith Barney analyst Thomos O'Donnell said he raised his target price on Washington Mutual stock to $67 per share from $56, and also raised earnings estimates.
-- He increased 1998 estimates to $4.85 per share from $4.60, and set a 1999 estimate of $5.80 per share.
-- O'Donnell cited the company's proposed acquisition of Great Western Financial Corp, which he said he expects both companies' shareholders to approve later this week.

-- "We believe earnings should grow sharply after the acquisition," O'Donnell said in his report. "Our view is based on the company's history of making successful acquisitions, plus its plans to substantially enhance revenue and cut costs."
